principles: Keep the docs truthful to the current CLI help surface.
Fix the source copy that can reintroduce the stale wording.
Prefer the smallest change that closes the audit drift without touching runtime behavior.
drivers: Prevent the same wrong serve examples from being copied back into future docs syncs.
Keep the user-facing onboarding path simple and accurate.

options.name: A: Edit CLAUDE.md only
pros: Fastest path to clear the visible mismatch.
Touches only the file that the findings point at.
cons: Leaves the stale wording in dev-cli.ts, which can keep the source copy inconsistent.
Does not address the likely origin of the wording.

options.name: B: Edit CLAUDE.md and packages/main/src/verifier/dev-cli.ts, then rerun framework audit
pros: Fixes the user-facing doc and the source copy together.
Lets the generated audit report refresh itself from the corrected sources.
cons: Touches one extra file and requires one audit rerun.
Slightly longer path than a single-file doc edit.

chosen: B: Edit CLAUDE.md and packages/main/src/verifier/dev-cli.ts, then rerun framework audit
rationale: The same stale serve wording exists in both the onboarding doc and the dev-cli source comment, so fixing only CLAUDE.md risks reintroducing the mismatch later. The audit report is generated by the audit handler, so the cleanest closure path is to fix both source copies and let the audit refresh the report.

preMortem.scenario: The audit still reports drift after the edits.
preMortem.trigger: A hidden stale serve reference remains in another docs file or generated template.
preMortem.consequence: F-012/F-013 stay open even though the obvious copies are fixed.
preMortem.mitigation: Search for remaining serve-web/serve-cli references and update the additional source before rerunning audit.

preMortem.scenario: The dev-cli comment is actually unused and the edit is unnecessary.
preMortem.trigger: The runtime never reads that comment, only the user-facing doc.
preMortem.consequence: We spend a small amount of extra time on a non-blocking source sync.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep the change to comment text only; no behavior change, so the extra edit is harmless.
